description: The requests of ./bench.sh smoke for a search role (a container with WEBAPP_ROLE=search). They go straight to the container through an SSH tunnel. No entry starts a search: a search that runs writes a history row to production, and a text without a stored reading can start a paid call. 'guards' says what each entry is for.

entries.guards: The readiness endpoint that the proxy asks every 2 seconds. A search role is ready once its search index has loaded.

The header search returns titles: it reads the search index and the people index in the role's memory, and sends no model call. It needs REC_NAVIGATION in the role's environment, or the answer is 404.

The search route answers in this role. One character of text is rejected after the in-flight limit and before the search starts (routes/api.combined-search.ts), so nothing is read, paid for, or written. A 503 with 'Search is busy' means that four searches were in flight, or that the process isn't a search role.
